message:
`npm test` now passes: 256 of 256 tests, with lint and `tsc` included.

The one failing test was `building rotation 0`, which expected 14 triangles and got 13. The source was right and the expectation was wrong. The `building` fixture is a simple 15-vertex polygon with no self-intersections, and any triangulation of an n-vertex simple polygon has exactly n−2 triangles, so 14 cannot be correct. The triangulation also has zero deviation, so I changed `test/expected.json` from `"building": 14` to `13`. I didn't touch `src/`.

Separately, `npm test` was failing before any test ran: `pretest` (eslint) couldn't find `eslint-config-mourner` because dependencies weren't installed. I ran `npm ci` to install the locked dependencies. That creates `node_modules/`, which is gitignored, so it doesn't show in the diff.

The only change in the working tree is `test/expected.json`. I haven't committed it.
